SOCIAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nakuru
   D. Mombasa

2. Which statement about Language groups in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Language groups in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Language groups in Eastern Africa.
   C. Say Language groups in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Language groups in Eastern Africa as rumours only.

3. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Hide all money underground

   A. Treat Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa as rumours only.

   C. Say Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)

   C. Name the president

   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Avoiding all community work

14. Which statement about Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
